patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often constrained to a central max-width container, frequently using a split-screen layout (image on one side, text on the other) for feature blocks.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, often using small uppercase labels for emphasis or categorization.
A deep blue and vibrant blue/purple gradient palette, contrasted with white text and surfaces, creating a professional yet energetic feel.
A multi-layered parallax effect in the hero section, combined with a sticky, transforming navigation bar and scroll-triggered fade-in/slide-up animations for subsequent content blocks.
Feature sections often present information in two-column layouts, alternating image and text positions, or in multi-column grids for smaller content cards (e.g., articles, device logos).

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a multi-layered parallax effect where the background gradient and the main hero image/video move at different, slower speeds than the scroll, creating a sense of depth.

The main navigation bar starts transparent and full-height, then becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, gaining a solid dark background and reducing its height and padding as the user scrolls down.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, likely triggered by scroll events using CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by readable body text and small uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and image overlays, maintaining a clean and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating a sense of openness, while internal content blocks maintain a more balanced density.

standout: The site distinctively integrates high-quality athletic imagery with sophisticated data visualizations, often presented with a subtle glassmorphism effect. This immediately communicates the product's value in a visually compelling and professional manner, setting it apart from generic fitness platforms.
